transfer.transport: mutually authenticated TLS directly between Macs; short-lived unique test CA
transfer.integrity: sender SHA-256 matched receiver streaming and reread SHA-256

reference.firstCase: both target logit hashes and draft logit hash match the three-Mac and independent single-Mac streaming run

verification: One candidate per prompt compared against the next full target step, serial greedy; not batched speculative verification.
inferenceTransport: temporary direct Tailscale TCP ring without application-level peer authentication; TLS applied to shard transfers only
scope: Experimental bounded test, not a persistent service. No speedup benchmark, long-context quality, MTP rollback, production loader parity, authenticated inference serving, cron integration or ten-host scheduling. The tenth Mac was not used because memory pressure and swap were high.
